about.text: Pasteurised whole milk with its full fat, at least 3.5 % in the EU, chilled and keeping about a week unopened in the fridge. In Germany it is sold as Frischmilch, as against the longer-keeping ESL and UHT milks.

sources.text: The photograph, its author and its licence, from its page.

how.text: Pasteurised milk is cooled at once, held in tanks and filled into bottles or cartons, then kept chilled. It keeps about a week unopened, and light spoils it faster than time does.
